label: reconstructed AI log for August integration testing
topic: M4 integration — leave request, coverage, blackout and shared calculation
record_status: RECONSTRUCTED — original Claude Code session log was unavailable

content: Review the integration between the leave request flow and M4. I want to make sure working-day calculation, coverage checks and blackout periods are enforced consistently.

Check the leave request flow from requested dates through server-side calculation, blackout evaluation and AI-2 coverage evaluation. The frontend may display warnings, but the backend must remain the source of truth.
What integration cases should I verify?

Verify a normal request, a request containing public holidays, a request that overlaps approved team leave, a request below minimum staffing, a BLOCK blackout, a SPECIAL_APPROVAL blackout and a request using a country with a non-default working-week configuration.

The final repository shows server-side coverage and blackout checks in leaveRequest.js and shared date logic in calculationService.js. This reduces the chance of different parts of the system calculating different leave durations.
Accepted: use the integration checklist and inspect the shared service calls rather than duplicating calculations.
